function: Estimates over-the-air reciprocity calibration coefficients (Tx/Rx RF-gain ratios) of distributed APs from bidirectional inter-AP pilots, so downlink channels follow from uplink estimates (p. 1, 2, 3).
system: Cell-free massive MIMO in TDD: M=30 single-antenna APs jointly serve K single-antenna users; no RIS; 3.5 GHz carrier, 20 MHz bandwidth (p. 2, 4).
method: Dual-head attention graph neural network (DH-GNN) with L=4 message-passing layers; supervised training with Adam on a scale-aligned squared-error loss (p. 3, 4).
data_channel: Own simulator: 30 APs in 1x1 km2, UMi-like path loss and shadowing, CN(0,1) small-scale fading, random RF gains; 20000 samples per setting (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Trained on mixed datasets covering all tested transmit powers, AP numbers, or topologies; tested on the held-out 20% of the same data (p. 4).
baselines: Non-learned: Argos and least-squares (LS) calibration. Learned: single-head attention GNN (SH-GNN), a one-head variant of the proposed network; no earlier learned calibration method (p. 1, 4).
metrics: NMSE of the calibration-coefficient vector after optimal complex scalar alignment, versus transmit power, number of APs, and topology (p. 4, 5).
complexity: Inference O(L(E+M)) for E directed edges: O(LM^2) fully connected, O(LkM) k-NN, O(LM) star; LS needs an SVD at O(M^3) (p. 3, 4).
q1_support: p. 4: "consistent with the 3GPP UMi street-canyon scenario"; only path loss and shadowing follow 3GPP, small-scale fading is CN(0,1) (p. 2); no TR 38.901 generator or measured data.
q2_support: p. 4: "trained on mixed datasets that cover all values of the varying parameter"; tests use the held-out 20% of the same data, so no unseen condition.
q3_support: p. 4: "we include Argos, LS, and a single-head attention-based GNN (SH-GNN)"; SH-GNN is a one-head variant of the proposed network, and p. 1: "reciprocity calibration remains unexplored" so no earlier learned baseline.
q4_support: p. 4: "the inference complexity scales as" O(L(E+M)), with O(LM^2) for fully connected graphs, versus O(M^3) for LS (p. 3).
q5_support: p. 4: "20000 independent samples are generated" by the authors' own simulation; the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public dataset.
notes: Borderline function: reciprocity calibration is read as uplink-to-downlink channel acquisition (area 2, p. 2: "infer the true DL channel"), although the output is the calibration vector and NMSE is on it. System is distributed MIMO (30 APs jointly serve users) although each node has one antenna (p. 2, footnote 1). Generalization claims rest on mixed training that covers all tested values (p. 4).
